text.en:
Amendment of the 94th Article of War. Article 94 of Commonwealth Act. No. 408, otherwise
known as the Articles of War, as amended, is further amended by deleting therefrom the following:
"Provided, That in time of peace, officers and enlisted men of the Philippine Constabulary shall not be triable
by courts-martial for any felony, crime, breach of law or violation of municipal ordinances committed under
this Article."

Effectivity. This decree shall take effect upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
